en: An old sepia-toned portrait photograph depicting a man dressed in elaborate clerical robes and religious insignia. He features a full beard and is wearing a large, distinctively shaped head covering typical of Eastern Orthodox Christian clergy. The photograph is bordered in black, with handwritten numbers on the upper left, a photographer's signature at the bottom left, and printed text indicating a photographic studio in Vienna (Wien).
